# Do not retain the 2024 hardcoded localization revision workaround

Entry 633 hardcodes a localization revision to unblock build_desktop_file.py during the localization repository transition. Current accepted build_desktop_file.py receives a JSON list of locales and a local translation root; it does not perform that revision checkout. Treat the old change as a temporary build workaround. Preserve current input contracts instead of copying the old revision into new tooling.

Scope: taskcluster/docker/recipes.

[Lesson record](../records/6016152cf5081fb9ad6b904c491c52fa8fa03c57a69c32363b4dac8722216da0.json).
